content:
Maria Chen: FYI RapidAudit confirmed — vendor kickoff Wed 09:00 PT. Opening this thread to lock down preflight items: RBAC deltas, KMS access pattern, audit capture, evidence packaging, and retest SLAs.
Akshay Patel: ack. Can we enumerate in-scope services one more time? gateway, inference runtime, telemetry pipeline?
Maria Chen: confirmed: hosted API, dedicated control plane, telemetry export pipeline. Out of scope: customer DBs and payment systems. I'll attach the assessor manifest to the intake.
Selene Li: Recommend ephemeral-assessor roles only. Best practice: AWS STS tokens with 2-hour max session. No long-lived creds.
Ben O'Neill: Agreed. Ops should flip audit sampling to full for the window and extend retention to 90 days. @oncall please prepare snapshot plan.
oncall: I can update retention and snapshot before the window. Need exact start/end times to schedule snapshot + export.
Maria Chen: Window: Wed 09:00–15:00 PT. Plan snapshot at 08:30, issue roles at 09:00. We'll run a 30-min dry-run beforehand.
Akshay Patel: KMS access: do we want to grant decrypt rights to assessors or proxy decrypt via ephemeral decryptor service?
Selene Li: Avoid direct KMS grants. Let's stand up an ephemeral decryptor service in a peered VPC that holds a short-lived KMS grant and logs decrypt operations with an assessor context.
Ben O'Neill: Implementation sketch: create a KMS grant scoped with EncryptionContextSubset=[{"assessor":"rapid-audit-001"}] for the ephemeral role. Example CLI snippet:
```bash
aws kms create-grant --key-id alias/pen-test-key --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/ephemeral-decryptor --operations Decrypt,GenerateDataKey --constraints EncryptionContextSubset={"assessor":"rapid-audit-001"}
```
Maria Chen: Good. Add a start/end audit marker and unique request-id prefix so we can prove decrypt calls belonged to the assessment.
Akshay Patel: RBAC delta proposal: read-only cluster-admin-ish for inference nodes, s3:GetObject/List for evidence buckets, ssm/describe for instance metadata. No write or IAM actions.
Selene Li: +1. Explicit deny: iam:*, kms:CreateKey, kms:ReEncrypt, s3:PutObject, dynamodb:UpdateItem. Keeper rule: no keystore writes by assessors.
Ben O'Neill: Draft IAM snippet I'll drop in intake doc. Rough example in JSON attached there.
Maria Chen: Evidence delivery: presigned manifests + read-only URLs only. No live DB queries by assessors. Also publish allowed CIDRs and user-agent strings.
Akshay Patel: Audit capture: ops create a log tag 'assessment=rapid-audit-001' on streams and enable request/response capture for /v1/generate and /v1/kvcache endpoints. Ensure redaction lambda runs before archiving to S3.
Selene Li: Important — mask prompt text and any tokens. Use existing redaction ruleset v2 and verify in dry-run.
Ben O'Neill: Retest model: critical findings -> emergency retest target within 72h (ops permitting). High/medium -> next scheduled retest window in the monthly cadence. Low -> tracked with regular patch cycles. We'll include this in the intake doc so assessor expectations are clear.
Akshay Patel: Who will track remediation tasks? I can own the vuln board and tag squad owners. Need infra and runtime POCs.
Selene Li: I'll own runtime fixes. Ben handles infra, S3, KMS. Maria is assessor liaison and escalation.
pen-test-bot: Reminder: upload assessor list, allowed CIDRs, intake manifest to /security/pen-tests/1719998500/ by EOD Monday.
Maria Chen: Checklist to complete: snapshot & retention, auditstream 100%, ephemeral decryptor + KMS grant, IAM policy draft, presigned URLs + manifest, smoke tests. Dry-run Tuesday 10:30 PT.
oncall: I'll run the snapshot once Maria confirms the bucket and will post the command output here.
Ben O'Neill: I'll paste IAM policy + KMS grant templates into the intake doc and tag the group.
Akshay Patel: Add simple smoke tests to the dry-run: 3 masked queries to /v1/generate, verify latency and confirm redaction.
Selene Li: Added smoke test steps to the dry-run agenda.
Maria Chen: If anyone hits blockers during the dry-run put them in this thread. Otherwise we'll close tasks after the dry-run and proceed. :thumbsup:
